# API endpoints - contract
# [backend] Append a row when you add an endpoint; regenerate a row when you change one.
#           Keep this in sync with the route + the Bruno request as ONE atomic change.
# [frontend] Read-only copy brought from the backend repo. Do not edit here.

| Method | Path | Auth | Request | Response | Notes |
|--------|------|------|---------|----------|-------|
| GET | /api/health | none | - | `{ data: [{ online: true }] }` | Liveness only (template). |
| GET | /api/ha/status | Bearer API_TOKEN | - | `{ data: [{ online: true, message, version }] }` | Checks HA link (`GET /api/` + `GET /api/config`). Errors: `ha_not_configured` 503, `ha_unreachable` 503, `ha_unauthorized` 502, `ha_unexpected_response` 502. |
| GET | /api/entities?domain=&area= | Bearer API_TOKEN | query: `domain` (HA domain), `area` (area id) both optional | `{ data: [{ entityId, domain, name, state, attributes, area, areaName, deviceName, lastChanged }] }` sorted by name | `area` = HA area id or null; `attributes` = safe subset; covers also carry `estimated_position` (0..100 or null). `deviceName` = HA device name (`name_by_user` or `name`) or null (no device / unknown); via HA `/api/template`, cached 60s, failure -> null. Unknown filter -> `[]`. Area via HA `/api/template`, cached 30s. |
| POST | /api/entities/:entityId/action | Bearer API_TOKEN | `{ "action": string, "params"?: { brightness, brightness_pct, color_temp, temperature, position, percentage, hvac_mode, preset_mode, volume_level } }`. Actions per domain: light/switch/fan/scene/script/media_player: `turn_on`, `turn_off`, `toggle`; cover: `open_cover`, `close_cover`, `stop_cover`, `set_cover_position` (`position`), `toggle`; climate: `turn_on`, `turn_off`, `set_temperature` (`temperature`), `set_hvac_mode` (`hvac_mode`), `set_preset_mode` (`preset_mode`); lock: `lock`, `unlock` | `{ data: [normalized entity] }` (new state; includes `deviceName`) | Domains allowlist: light, switch, climate, cover, fan, media_player, scene, script, lock. For a calibrated cover, a running timed move is cancelled: `stop_cover` keeps the elapsed estimate; `open_cover`/`close_cover` start a full-leg timer (position `null` until it ends at 100/0); other cover actions make the position `null`. Errors: `invalid_entity_id` 400, `invalid_action` 400 (action not valid for the entity's domain), `invalid_params` 400, `domain_not_allowed` 403, `entity_not_found` 404. |
| GET | /api/areas | Bearer API_TOKEN | - | `{ data: [{ areaId, name, entities: [normalized entity] }] }` (covers include `attributes.estimated_position`) (every normalized entity includes `deviceName`, resolved with the cached 60s device index) | Areas from HA (empty ones included) sorted by name, plus a final `{ areaId: null, name: "Unassigned" }` group. Each entity appears exactly once; entities sorted by name. Reuses HA `/api/template` (cached 30s) and `/api/states`. |
| GET | /api/stream?domain=&once= | Bearer API_TOKEN, or `?token=API_TOKEN` (EventSource fallback; only this route) | query: `domain` (plain HA domain, `^[a-z_]+$`, optional), `once=1` (smoke mode: send `ready` and close) | SSE `text/event-stream`: `event: ready` `data: {domain}` first, then `event: state_changed` `data: normalized entity` per HA change; `: ping` every 25s | `state_changed` data carries the normalized entity incl. `deviceName` and, for covers, `attributes.estimated_position`. One shared HA WebSocket for all clients (opened on first client, closed on last). Reconnects with backoff 1s..30s. Errors before the stream opens: `invalid_domain` 400, `missing_credentials` 401, `not_authorized` 403. Never log the query string. |
| GET | /api/history?entityIds=&hours= | Bearer API_TOKEN | query: `entityIds` (comma-separated, required, max 20 distinct, entity id regex), `hours` (int 1..720, default 24) | `{ data: [{ entityId, points: [{ t: ISO, v: string }] }] }` one item per requested entity, request order; `points: []` when HA has no history | Source: HA `/api/history/period` with `minimal_response` and `significant_changes_only`, window = last `hours` up to now. Errors: `missing_entity_ids` 400, `invalid_entity_id` 400, `too_many_entities` 400, `invalid_hours` 400. |
| GET | /api/aliases | Bearer API_TOKEN | - | `{ data: [{ entityId, alias }] }` sorted by `entityId`; `data: []` when empty | User-editable friendly names, served from memory (loaded from `ALIASES_FILE` at startup). Entities/areas/stream never carry `alias`; the client merges. |
| PUT | /api/aliases/:entityId | Bearer API_TOKEN | body `{ "alias": string }` | `{ data: [{ entityId, alias }] }` (stored, normalized value) | Creates or replaces. `alias` normalized: trim + collapse whitespace runs to one space; 1..80 chars, no control chars. No HA call (works while HA is down). Errors: `invalid_entity_id` 400 (regex `^[a-z_]+\.[a-z0-9_]+$`), `invalid_alias` 400 (missing, non-string, empty, >80, control chars), `too_many_aliases` 400 (would create alias #2001; replacing is always allowed), `aliases_write_failed` 500 (memory unchanged). |
| DELETE | /api/aliases/:entityId | Bearer API_TOKEN | - | `{ data: [] }` | Idempotent: 200 also when no alias existed. Errors: `invalid_entity_id` 400, `aliases_write_failed` 500. |
| GET | /api/calibrations | Bearer API_TOKEN | - | `{ data: [{ entityId, openMs, closeMs, position, calibratedAt }] }` sorted by `entityId`; `data: []` when empty | Cover travel-time calibrations (open/close duration in ms), served from memory (loaded from `CALIBRATIONS_FILE` at startup). `position` is `null` (unknown) until a percent calibration exists. No HA call. |
| PUT | /api/calibrations/:entityId | Bearer API_TOKEN | body `{ "openMs": int, "closeMs": int }` | `{ data: [{ entityId, openMs, closeMs, position, calibratedAt }] }` (stored entry; `position` reset to `null`) | Creates or replaces. Integers 500..300000. Only `cover` entities. No HA call (works while HA is down). Errors: `invalid_entity_id` 400 (regex `^[a-z_]+\.[a-z0-9_]+$`), `domain_not_allowed` 403 (not a `cover`), `invalid_calibration` 400 (missing, non-integer, out of range), `too_many_calibrations` 400 (would create entry #201; replacing is always allowed), `calibrations_write_failed` 500 (memory unchanged). |
| DELETE | /api/calibrations/:entityId | Bearer API_TOKEN | - | `{ data: [] }` | Idempotent: 200 also when no calibration existed. Errors: `invalid_entity_id` 400, `domain_not_allowed` 403, `calibrations_write_failed` 500. |
| POST | /api/entities/:entityId/cover-percent | Bearer API_TOKEN | body `{ "percent": int }` (0..100, 100 = fully open) | `{ data: [normalized entity] }` (`attributes.estimated_position` = live estimate) | Requires a calibration (010). Targets 0 and 100 drive the full leg (+10% margin, works with unknown position, no stop); intermediate targets need a known position and send `stop_cover` after the proportional time. A new request cancels a running move (stop_cover, estimate kept). Position is persisted at move end/cancel and set to `null` when a move starts. No HA call before validation and calibration. Errors: `invalid_entity_id` 400, `domain_not_allowed` 403 (not a `cover`), `invalid_params` 400 (percent not an integer 0..100), `not_calibrated` 409, `position_unknown` 409 (intermediate target, unknown position), `entity_not_found` 404. |
